I wish she wasn't here. She's the only person that just wastes away in Crucible. She's meant to be exploring - and she just can't. And some of her iterations... it hurts my soul how much suffering she's in.

I know I say no one should leave Crucible, but... I mean no one but her. I sense no malice in her, no deception. She's always an aviator. Forever grounded in our Purgatory.
